headline: S&P 500 Pulls Back 10% From Peak Into Correction Territory Amid AI Concerns
summary: The U.S. stock market has declined 10% from its record high set last month. The drop for the S&P 500 puts the index into a technical correction as investors evaluate hurdles facing the artificial intelligence sector.
why: A 10% correction in the S&P 500 represents a key technical threshold that often triggers portfolio hedging, margin adjustments, and broader risk re-evaluations.

impacts.name: S&P 500
impacts.why: The index entered a technical correction after declining 10% from its recent peak.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Equities fell into correction territory amid mounting investor concerns over the sustainability of high valuations and growth hurdles in the AI industry.
